name: TB-21007
summary: TB-21007 is a nootropic drug which acts as a subtype-selective inverse agonist at the α5 containing GABAA receptors.

pharmacology.text: TB-21007 is a nootropic drug which acts as a subtype-selective inverse agonist at the α5 containing GABAA receptors.

uses.en: It is a research compound studied in animals for possible memory-enhancing effects.
uses.zh: 它是一種研究用化合物，曾在動物身上研究其可能的增強記憶作用。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种研究用化合物，曾在动物身上研究其可能的增强记忆作用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Inverse agonists at the benzodiazepine site can cause anxiety and seizures, although α5-selective ones were designed to avoid this.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平結合位的反向促效劑可能引起焦慮與癲癇發作，不過α5選擇性的藥物在設計上就是為了避免這些問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平结合位的反向促效剂可能引起焦虑与癫痫发作，不过α5选择性的药物在设计上就是为了避免这些问题。

fact.en: It does the reverse of a benzodiazepine at the α5 type of GABA-A receptor, a subtype involved in memory, which is why drugs like it were explored as memory enhancers.
fact.zh: 它在α5型GABA-A受體上的作用與苯二氮平相反，而這個亞型與記憶有關，因此這類藥物曾被探索作為增強記憶的藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它在α5型GABA-A受体上的作用与苯二氮平相反，而这个亚型与记忆有关，因此这类药物曾被探索作为增强记忆的药物。
